name: Nua na Rede: A Verdade Sobre Rose Leonel
original_name: Nua na Rede: A Verdade Sobre Rose Leonel
overview: A series of reviews of the real case of the star Rose Leonel, who was in Maring, took 20 years. A photo exhibition of former new photos was shown, resulting in criticism from Lei Rose Leonel (Lei no. 13772), who criminalized harassment of the mulher.
